records.name: N/A - Not an independent seat
records.notes: UF Online is a fully-online degree delivery program/division of the University of Florida, not a separately chartered community college with its own president. It is led by a Director/Associate Provost who reports up through UF's Provost and ultimately the University of Florida's president (an office that has itself seen recent turnover, e.g., Ben Sasse's 2024 resignation and subsequent interim/permanent leadership at UF). There is no independent 'president' seat for UF Online to trace; research confirms this is not a real standalone community-college leadership position.
